name: Counter-Strike 2 / HLTV
description: English to Simplified Chinese terminology for HLTV navigation, news, events, matches, and team pages, including Counter-Strike 2 statistics, tactics, weapons, maps, roster news, and Fantasy. Includes original-name entries for sampled teams and players.
